Baruipur rape-murder accused killed in police encounter

The main accused in the Baruipur rape and murder case, Prabash Mondal, was killed in a police encounter. Police claim Mondal attempted to snatch a firearm and fired at officers while being taken to the crime scene for reconstruction. The incident has drawn political attention, with the victim's mother refusing to accept the body.
